item.title: sharing one memory bus on apple silicon
item.description: An assistant on your laptop rarely runs one model. A chat model writes the reply, and smaller helper models run beside it. On Apple Silicon they all share one pool of memory. I measured how much they slow each other down, found a simple rule for it, and built a scheduler that fixes most of the damage.
